jobs.title: Facilities Product Manager - FFP - Healthcare+
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Facilities Product Manager - FFP is responsible for providing oversight, innovation, and standards to support development of and enhancement to new and existing Healthcare + Products and/or suite of products. Provides subject matter expertise in a defined category in order to build relationships with external suppliers and developers as well as supports internal regions and accounts in the implementation and improvement of systems, standards, and processes to ensure consistency of Aramark's operating programs and consistency of Aramark's operating capability from one facility to the next.

**This is a remote, work-from-home, role with national travel. Proximity to a major airport is preferred.
Travel: Expected to travel up to 70%.

Job Responsibilities

- Functions as a Subject Matter Expert in at least one of the following service lines as segmented by the Product and Innovations Team - Chemicals
- System Automation/Innovation
- FFP (or other designated program)
- Mobile Medical Equipment

- Supports the Aramark Programs through training, virtual and onsite.
- Acts as the liaison to Aramark approved vendors for equipment, supplies products. - Subject Matter Expert in key Aramark facility programs
- Provide national support to computerized maintenance management system relative to system operation, development upgrades, enhancements and or training.
- Support on-site services to to both existing facilities and as an SME in mobilizations Service Lines:
- Provide support to the Center of Excellence Project Managers, Regional staff and Operations teams for new facility management mobilizations and ensure the full implementation of Aramark's operating programs. - Utilize technical expertise to evaluate Aramark's operating program standards, measure performance and recommend solutions in order to enhance or improve operations.
- Works with Project Manager assigned to the mobilization and prepares operational and budget trackers to ensure a smooth on time and on budget mobilization.

- Works in partnership with other Portfolio leaders to ensure success across accounts

- Use operational expertise to pilot and implement new and existing systems and technologies.
- Publish and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for each specific line of service.
- Represent Healthcare + Center of Excellence in the development, testing, and piloting of new technology, programs, and systems.
- Develop, implement, and maintain Facilities resources
- Assist in the development, implementation, and facilitation of technical training programs for Healthcare + Facilities Front Line managers and employees.
- Assess and monitor select accounts through compliance audits to ensure compliance with our client contracts, OSHA, Life Safety, and other local, state, and federal regulations, and financial obligations.
- Collaborate nationally with the Healthcare + Region and Growth Teams to support selected new facilities sales efforts through conducting new business surveys and assistance in the development of business models for potential client opportunities.
- Collaborate nationally with the Healthcare + Region and Growth Teams to support facilities programs in selected retention efforts.
- Document observations and recommendations with formal reporting methods for client and internal audiences.
- Exemplify Aramark's safety culture and participate in Aramark SAFE practices.
- Adhere to all established systems and training programs to provide a safe working environment.
- Comply with OSHA, EPA, and other local, state, and federal regulations.
- Maintain compliance with Aramark's standards of operation, Compliance Reporting and Business Conduct Policies.
- Other duties as assigned.

At Aramark, developing new skills and doing what it takes to get the job done make a positive impact for our employees and for our customers. In order to meet our commitments, job duties may change or new ones may be assigned without formal notice.

Qualifications

- Managers should have three to five years of management and technical experience in Facilities Management related field, preference for Healthcare Experience
- Bachelor's degree in facilities management or equivalent experience
- Professional Associations preferred with AHE ASHE ALM, preferred or ability to secure
- Survey knowledge of Joint Commission standards
- Excellent oral and written communication skills
- Good presentation skills to customers and internal clients
- Proficient training skills for technical and classrooms sessions
- Proficient in report writing and writing policy and procedures
- Excellent listening skills
- Excellent organizational and time management skills
- Ability to work independently
- Excellent computer skills
- Management skills
- Excellent financial and data analysis and Interpretation skills

Education

Rooted in service and united by our purpose, we strive to do great things for each other, our partners, our communities, and our planet.

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Senior Product Owner will define and execute product strategy for a portfolio of hospitality commerce solutions that may span ordering, transactions, customer engagement, and supporting technology integrations. This role owns the full product lifecycle, from roadmap and delivery through vendor management, implementation, support, performance, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate combines product leadership, technical fluency, business insight, and customer empathy. This individual must be comfortable managing multiple products simultaneously, leading cross-functional teams, resolving high-impact issues, and using data to improve customer experience and business results. Ability and willingness to travel approximately 30% of the time for client site visits, product deployments, pilot launches, operational reviews, vendor meetings, stakeholder workshops, industry events, and field research activities.

Job Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Portfolio Management
- Define and maintain the vision, strategy, roadmap, and prioritized backlog for multiple products and platforms.
- Balance customer needs, business objectives, technical constraints, resources, timelines, budgets, and risk across the product portfolio.
- Gather and prioritize opportunities, requirements, user feedback, operational needs, and market insights to maximize business value.
- Lead products through iterative discovery, design, development, launch, adoption, optimization, and retirement.
Product Performance & Accountability
- Own the overall performance and success of assigned products throughout their lifecycle.
- Define and monitor key performance indicators for adoption, engagement, reliability, transaction volume, customer satisfaction, operational efficiency, and financial performance.
- Use product data, customer feedback, and operational insights to identify performance gaps and drive measurable improvement plans.
- Communicate product health, risks, opportunities, priorities, and results to business and technology leaders.
Vendor & Integration Management
- Serve as the primary business owner and point of contact for product vendors and technology partners.
- Manage vendor relationships, roadmaps, contractual commitments, service expectations, performance, escalations, and delivery accountability.
- Lead the evaluation, onboarding, and governance of third-party solutions and oversee integrations with POS, payments, loyalty, identity, inventory, fulfillment, and other connected systems.
- Coordinate internal and external teams to meet business, technical, security, compliance, deployment, and support requirements.
Cross-Functional Leadership & Delivery
- Lead collaboration across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Information Security, Operations, Deployment, Support, Marketing, Sales, Finance, Procurement, clients, and vendor teams.
- Build alignment and drive decisions across diverse stakeholder groups, including teams with competing priorities and dependencies.
- Contribute to sprint and release planning, testing, implementation, and retrospectives while ensuring solutions meet business requirements and quality standards.
- Develop repeatable intake, deployment, documentation, training, support, and operational transition processes.
Support, Escalation & Governance
- Serve as the primary point of escalation for product-related issues affecting clients, operations, support teams, or business stakeholders.
- Lead cross-functional resolution of critical incidents, service disruptions, defects, and high-impact operational challenges, including timely stakeholder communication.
- Track product and project risks, issues, dependencies, mitigation plans, and decisions through resolution.
- Guide products through security, architecture, procurement, compliance, and other governance reviews, engaging vendors and subject matter experts as needed.
- Serve as the product subject matter expert and support client reviews, product evaluations, RFP responses, and strategic initiatives.

Qualifications

Required
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Engineering, or a related field.
- Five or more years of experience in product management, product ownership, business analysis, project management, or a related technology leadership role.
- Demonstrated success managing and delivering multiple products, platforms, or technology solutions simultaneously in a mid-sized or large organization.
- Experience managing vendor relationships, third-party integrations, client expectations, product deliverables, and operational support models.
- Strong understanding of Agile delivery, product lifecycle management, and data-informed decision-making.
- Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence without direct authority, and communicate effectively with business and technical audiences.
- Strong organizational, prioritization, analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and translate complex business and technical challenges into actionable plans.
Preferred
- Experience with food service, hospitality, restaurant, retail commerce, workplace dining, or digital ordering technology solutions.
- Hands-on experience with food technology ecosystems, including POS, mobile ordering, kiosks, payments, loyalty, inventory, fulfillment, and customer engagement platforms.
- Experience working with food technology vendors and integrating enterprise systems with third-party platforms.
- Experience supporting large-scale client deployments, product launches, and ongoing operations.
- Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Travel Requirements
Ability and willingness to travel approximately 30% of the time for client site visits, product deployments, pilot launches, operational reviews, vendor meetings, stakeholder workshops, industry events, and field research activities.
